audience.text: Go developers building server-side or cross-platform desktop applications that require PDF processing without external dependencies.

capabilities.text: Split, merge, extract, rotate, reorder, and resize pages; manage page labels, open actions, transitions, and metadata (Info/XMP) round-trip.
capabilities.title: Page operations and metadata

capabilities.text: Apply password-based encryption (RC4/AES-128/AES-256) with granular permissions; sign with PKCS#7/PAdES, add timestamps, and verify signatures with LTV support.
capabilities.title: Encryption and digital signatures

capabilities.text: Lay out paragraphs, headings, images, tables, and lists top-to-bottom with automatic pagination, multi-column support, and tagged PDF generation.
capabilities.title: Content authoring with Flow

capabilities.text: Build multi-page tables with cell merging, styling, and images; draw lines, rectangles, circles, paths, gradients, and tiling patterns directly on pages.
capabilities.title: Tables and vector graphics

capabilities.text: Create and manipulate all standard field types including barcode fields; manage annotations (link, highlight, text, stamp, redact) with auto-regenerated appearance streams.
capabilities.title: AcroForms and annotations

capabilities.text: Validate structural integrity, PDF/A-1/2/3/4 conformance, and PDF/UA accessibility; convert documents toward compliance and embed fonts automatically.
capabilities.title: PDF/A, PDF/UA, and validation

capabilities.text: Export to HTML, SVG, Markdown, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB; render pages to PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF with a pure-Go anti-aliased rasterizer.
capabilities.title: Conversion and rendering

capabilities.text: Summarize documents, perform OCR, answer questions with chat history, and generate alt text for figures over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
capabilities.title: AI copilots

limitations.text: Linearization cannot be combined with encryption or digital signing in the same document.
Certificate-based encryption accepts RSA recipients only; elliptic curve recipients and legacy RC4 sub-filters are not written.
OpenType shaping covers Arabic-family, Hebrew, and simple scripts; Indic, Khmer, Myanmar, and Hangul reordering shapers and vertical text are not implemented.
ConvertToPDFA embeds fonts only when a face is available; Symbol and ZapfDingbats require registration via AddFontFile/AddFontFolder.
The built-in renderer does not support mesh shadings (PDF shading types 4-7); other shading types, patterns, and blend modes render normally.
MarkdownToDocument has no syntax highlighting; SaveMarkdown does not reconstruct tables and caps inferred heading levels at 3.

problems_solved.text: Enables PDF processing in pure Go environments where CGo or native libraries are undesirable or prohibited.
Provides a complete, self-contained PDF toolkit with no transitive dependencies, simplifying deployment and CI/CD.
Supports modern PDF standards including PDF/UA accessibility, PDF/A archival compliance, and digital signatures with LTV support.

product_summary.text: A pure Go, 100% open-source PDF library with no CGo, native dependencies, or third-party packages, supporting creation, editing, conversion, signing, encryption, validation, and AI-powered document processing.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported PDF/A-4 rules and veraPDF alignment is not quantified beyond a sample of 337 documents.
Whether the AI copilots support non-English models or multi-language documents beyond OcrOptions.Language is not specified.
The behavior of Table when RowSpan splits across a page break is not described.
Whether content-driven auto-fit column widths are planned or explicitly out of scope is not stated.
The exact set of SVG features unsupported (e.g., <textPath>, vertical writing) is listed but not prioritized.
Whether the renderer supports ICCBased CMYK profiles beyond recoloring is unclear.
The exact behavior of ReplaceText across multiple lines is partially described but not fully.
Whether the TableAbsorber handles borderless tables with inconsistent row lengths is not specified.

workflows.name: Create and edit PDFs
workflows.text: Open existing PDFs with Open/OpenStream or create new ones with NewDocument/NewDocumentFromFormat, then edit pages, add content, and save with Save/WriteTo.

workflows.name: Build documents with Flow layout
workflows.text: Use Document.NewFlow to create documents top-to-bottom with automatic pagination, adding paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists, then Render to produce pages.

workflows.name: Process forms and annotations
workflows.text: Add and manipulate AcroForm fields (text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, push button, barcode) and annotations (link, highlight, text, stamp, redact) via Form and Page APIs.

workflows.name: Convert and render
workflows.text: Convert PDFs to HTML, SVG, Markdown, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, or TIFF using Save*/Write* methods; render pages to PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF images with the built-in renderer.

workflows.name: Apply AI capabilities
workflows.text: Use the ai subpackage to summarize documents, perform OCR on scanned pages, answer questions with chat history, or generate alt text for figures over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
